company.name: Trmem
company.shortDescription: Trmem is the first Saudi platform connecting contractors and engineers with clients, making construction and renovation faster and easier.
company.description:
Trmem is the first Saudi digital platform that brings together contractors, engineers, and clients in one integrated marketplace for construction, renovation, and interior design projects.

The platform empowers clients to easily find, compare, and hire qualified professionals across multiple specialties — from home renovations and annex building to full-scale construction. With its contractor evaluation system, professional tiering, and verified directory, Trmem ensures trust and transparency in every project.

For contractors and engineers, Trmem provides access to a continuous stream of projects, enabling them to grow their business, build their reputation, and reach new clients. The platform also offers value-added services, including maintenance contract management, partnerships with suppliers, and subscription-based professional tools.

By digitizing and simplifying the renovation and construction process, Trmem is transforming the Saudi construction market, making it faster, more transparent, and more efficient for both clients and professionals.
